verdict: No unresolved runtime/API/test P0, P1 or P2 finding in the reviewed delta.

source_evidence.claim: Only continuous pending Input uses completion plus interval. Background still uses start plus interval, while Force and drained Input render immediately.
Every real Render decision clears the previous completion and records a fresh start. Image/deferred work therefore uses the new start fallback, rather than an old completion.
completed mutates only the completion timestamp. Requests raised before/during presentation retain their Input/Background/Force authority and priority.

The sole production completed call follows the normal synchronous Build and time_present return. It is absent from image/MSX, deferred, Idle and Wait_until branches. The sole take call belongs to this same serial UI loop; no older completion can arrive after a later take in this caller.
Pending Input/Force input timeout remains zero, allowing queued input to be consumed while a render is coalesced. Background timeout still uses its unchanged start deadline.
Implementation and mli completed signatures agree. New tests assert state decisions for overrun, pending requests, Force, Background and no-work start fallback; they add no UI wording/layout oracle.

known_pending_documentation.status: Parent explained this is preserved B documentation from an earlier unpublished docs commit. C has no PR yet and its own numbered fragment is pending PR creation. This is recorded separately from runtime findings.

limits: No runtime latency/GC/allocation improvement is established by source review.
The synchronous sole-caller ordering is part of the current call-site argument; this API does not provide a token for future asynchronous/reentrant frame completions.
Native compilation, focused scheduler tests and actual burst/mixed PTY behavior remain separate evidence.
